meta.source: Kindling site comps, palette screenshot and brand hex values from the owner; text sizes and spacing estimated
meta.note: Ink #381105, orange #FF6800, white #FFF5E5, olive #D4C284 and amber #FF9E37 are the owner's stated values. Tint steps and `paper` were sampled or derived from the comps.

color.note: One light theme. Dark brown ink, one orange accent, brand white, two supporting accents.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background: the ground every section sits on. Sampled from the site comps (the brand white `cream` is a warmer #FFF5E5; confirm which one grounds the page). Text on it is `ink` (16.1:1) or `ink-2` (5.5:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the wordmark on `paper`, `cream`, `amber`, `olive` and `orange` (16.1:1, 15.6:1, 8.2:1, 9.5:1 and 5.8:1). Also the outline of tertiary buttons and the deep block in layouts. The brand's dark brown, never pure black.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `paper` (5.5:1), `cream` (5.3:1) and `cream-2` (4.8:1): captions, helper copy, partner names. Derived: `ink` at 66% over `paper`. Not for text on `orange` or `amber`.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Non-text only: disabled outlines, dividers heavier than `hairline`, corner brackets. Derived: `ink` at 34% over `paper`. 2.1:1 on `paper`, so never body text. Reads at 7.5:1 on `ink` for large marks.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary button fill, italic accent phrases, chevron markers, card titles, mono index numerals. On `ink` it reads 5.8:1 (text OK). On `paper` it is 2.78:1, below the 3:1 floor for large text and 4.5:1 for small: the comps use it that way, so keep it to display sizes, markers and fills, and set small text in `ink`.

tokens.name: orange-2
tokens.usage: Lighter orange tint: hover fills and quiet highlights behind `ink` text (7.9:1). Derived: `orange` at 66% over `paper`.

tokens.name: orange-3
tokens.usage: Palest orange tint: warm panel backgrounds behind `ink` text (11.2:1). Derived: `orange` at 34% over `paper`.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: The brand white: text and marks on `ink` (15.6:1), labels on `orange` fills (2.69:1, the brand's own pairing), photo captions, and warm panel backgrounds behind `ink` text (15.6:1). Nearly identical to `paper`, so separate panels from the page with a `hairline`, not shade alone.

tokens.name: cream-2
tokens.usage: Warm grey step sampled from the palette: table stripes and inset panels. `ink` 14.1:1, `ink-2` 4.8:1.

tokens.name: cream-3
tokens.usage: Warm grey step sampled from the palette: neutral fills behind imagery placeholders. `ink` text only.

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Sage-khaki secondary accent, used for editorial blocks and chart series. `ink` on it is 9.5:1; never text in `olive`.

tokens.name: olive-2
tokens.usage: Lighter olive tint for quiet blocks behind `ink` text (11.5:1). Derived: `olive` at 66% over `paper`.

tokens.name: olive-3
tokens.usage: Palest olive tint for neutral panels behind `ink` text. Derived: `olive` at 34% over `paper`.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Warm secondary accent for highlights and second chart series; `ink` on it is 8.2:1. Never text in `amber` on light grounds.

tokens.name: amber-2
tokens.usage: Lighter amber tint for quiet highlight blocks behind `ink` text (10.2:1). Derived: `amber` at 66% over `paper`.

tokens.name: amber-3
tokens.usage: Palest amber tint for warm panels behind `ink` text. Derived: `amber` at 34% over `paper`.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px grid lines drawn behind every section on `paper` (the faint column and row rules in the comps). Decorative: it carries no meaning, so 1.1:1 is intended.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Alias of `cream`, the brand white (#FFF5E5): label on `orange` fills (2.69:1, below 4.5:1: the brand's own pairing, kept exact; use `ink` on orange where legibility matters), captions and overlays on photography.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Alias: page background.

tokens.name: surface-warm
tokens.usage: Alias: warm band or panel background.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Alias: default text on `surface` and `surface-warm`.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Alias: secondary text on `surface` and `surface-warm`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Alias: the single accent for fills, markers and display-size accents.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Alias: label on an `accent` fill (brand pairing, 2.69:1; see `white`).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Alias: background grid rules.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Alias: 1px outline of tertiary buttons, frame edges and caption boxes.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline in Syne. Sentence case, ink on paper. Pair with `accent-italic` for the closing phrase.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Card and section titles in Syne, often set in `orange` (display size only).

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Overlay headlines on full-bleed photography, in `white`.

styles.name: accent-italic
styles.usage: Texturina italic in `orange` for the closing phrase of a Syne headline; same size and line height as the headline beside it.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Kindling uncovers the story at the heart of your company.
styles.usage: Sub-headline under a hero headline, in Instrument Sans.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Put the right story in front of the right people.
styles.usage: Card and paragraph copy in Instrument Sans.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Buttons, nav links and list items in Instrument Sans.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Helper text and labels in Instrument Sans.

styles.name: mono-caption
styles.usage: Timecode overlay on photography in Roboto Mono, set uppercase in `white`, bottom-left, four short lines.

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: Index numerals (01, 02) and stage labels in Roboto Mono, uppercase.

spacing.note: Estimated 4px scale from the comps; confirm against the source frames.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a marker and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside a button or caption.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked caption lines and list items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between related elements.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a card image and its title; button gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sibling cards.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between a headline block and its content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding, small.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding, large.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: All buttons, cards, images and inputs. Corners are square; the only cut is the diagonal chamfer on photo frames.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Outline of buttons and frames; grid rules.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasised outline for focus rings and selected frames.
